Test Case Title: Verify text fields accept valid Name, Email, Phone and Address
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid name in the Name field 2. Enter a valid email in the Email field 3. Enter a phone number in the Phone field 4. Enter an address in the Address field 5. Read back the value of every field
Test Data: Name: Allah Ditta; Email: allah.ditta@example.com; Phone: 3001234567; Address: House 10, Street 5, Islamabad, Pakistan
Expected Result: Every field shows exactly the value that was entered

Test Case Title: Verify Gender radio buttons are mutually exclusive
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Steps: 1. Select the 'Male' radio button 2. Verify Male is selected and Female is not 3. Select the 'Female' radio button 4. Verify Female is selected and Male is not
Expected Result: Only one radio button is selected at any time; selecting Female deselects Male

Test Case Title: Verify all Days checkboxes can be selected and unselected
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Test Steps: 1. Tick all 7 day checkboxes (Sunday to Saturday) 2. Verify all 7 are selected 3. Untick all 7 checkboxes 4. Verify none is selected
Test Data: Days: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
Expected Result: All checkboxes toggle independently; after unticking, no day remains selected

Test Case Title: Verify only the selected Days checkboxes are checked
